source.archive: Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art, Charles Lang Freer Papers
source.processing: Direct facsimile render plus Smithsonian supplied text/transcription companions; keyword sweep of all 1036 pages; no OCR.

evidence.instrument: Handwritten receipt on Shepheard's Hotel and Ghezireh Palace, The Egyptian Hotels Ltd. stationery
evidence.signature_provenance: Handwritten apparent signature on original, not a legal forensic authentication
evidence.stated_transaction: One lot of antiquities sold to Charles Freer
evidence.stated_receipt_amount: 365 pounds and 10 shillings (visible handwritten wording; old-currency typography uncertain)
evidence.handwritten_contact_line: M. Nahman / Credit foncier Egyptien / Cairo (Egypt)
evidence.address_interpretation: Contact/banking address in Cairo, not demonstrably shop premises or evidence of Nahman & Co. legal form

evidence.addressee_line: TO Chas. L. Freer, Detroit, Michigan

key_items.object: Bronze figure, King, with gold inlay

evidence.mismatch_with_handwritten_receipt: Receipt appears to state 365 pounds 10 shillings. Discrepancy of 5 shillings remains unresolved. Could reflect separate adjustment or reading error; do not harmonize without further documentation.
evidence.archaeology_firewall: Seller's object-origin claims are not verified excavation provenances; Osiris figurine from Mitraheema does not connect to Mendes 1902 gold material.

evidence.text_as_written: Mr M. Nahman / No. 1 Godot de Mauroy / Paris
evidence.address_scope: Reported Paris contact address, not verified Cairo shop address

scan_keyword_audit.scope_limit: Only indexed transcriptions were string-searched. No claim of negative search across every original scanned image.

cross_temporal.common_contact_reference: Credit Foncier Egyptien / Cairo appears on signed 1908 receipt and Credit Foncier care-of routing appears in 1909 bank records.
cross_temporal.corporate_equivalence_not_proven: Freer original documents explicitly say Maurice Nahman (1908 and 1909) and Mr. M. Nahman (1909 consular form); none of the reviewed originals proves that 1904 Bowdoin Nahman & Co. was the same corporate/legal entity.
cross_temporal.distinct_archaeological_lineage: No direct relationship between this dealer's objects and Mendes 1902 CG 53469 gold objects established.

next_gate: Get Bowdoin 1904 original consular certificate via permitted access process; compare exact full corporate name, individuals, signers/agents, company seals, any case/invoice cross-identifiers, Cairo/Paris banking contacts. Do not equate Nahman & Co. with Maurice Nahman absent a binding primary record.
